Sir Keir Starmer confirmed he will stay in touch with Donald Trump after leaving office, despite previous public disagreements over military policy and trade.

The Bright Side:
Maintaining open lines of communication between world leaders, even when they disagree, is essential for global stability and security.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is in the HOW plane; the causal chain of 'shared values' is contradicted by the 'trade war' threats, showing the relationship is transactional, not personal.

Social Physics Analysis:
This is a case of transparency vs. pretext. The leaders use the language of personal rapport to mask the underlying transactional nature of the UK-US alliance.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Good Preference. The goal is stability, even if the rapport is performative.

The Unavoidable Truth: The UK-US relationship is primarily strategic and transactional.

The Unavoidable Lie: The relationship is built on deep personal shared values.
